title: Star Frontier War
description: Command an interstellar cruiser patrolling the galaxy rim—upgrade twin plasma turrets and blast alien fleets across deep-space sectors.
controls: Drag to pilot your starship, dodge cosmic plasma fire, and grab weapon power-ups.

zh-CN.title: 星河边境战记
zh-CN.description: 浩瀚星际弹幕空战星河边境：驾驶星舰守卫银河防线，强化等离子重炮扫荡外星舰队爽感拉满！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动战舰灵活闪避敌弹，拾取星际武装升级火力摧毁敌舰。
